text: I'd say the most important quality is patience, because students learn at very different speeds, and a teacher who gets irritated quickly can put people off a subject for life. Beyond that, good teachers need to be able to explain things in more than one way. For example, if a student doesn't understand a grammar rule from a table, a good teacher might use a story or a real-life situation instead.

tips.en: One quality with an explanation, then a second — the answer develops rather than lists.
tips.kk: Алдымен түсіндірмесі бар бір қасиет, сосын екіншісі — жауап тізбе емес, дамып отырады.
tips.ru: Сначала одно качество с объяснением, потом второе — ответ развивается, а не перечисляет.
tips.example: I'd say the most important quality is patience

tips.en: Part 3 rewards developing ideas: an example makes the point convincing.
tips.kk: Part 3 ойды дамыту қабілетін бағалайды: мысал оны сенімді етеді.
tips.ru: Part 3 оценивает умение развить мысль: пример делает её убедительной.
tips.example: For example, if a student doesn't understand a grammar rule

note.en: A phrasal verb: “make people lose interest”.

questions.question: What qualities make a good teacher?

text: Not completely, in my view. Online lessons are brilliant for flexibility — people in small towns can now take courses from top universities, which was impossible twenty years ago. However, I think younger children in particular need a teacher physically in the room, partly to keep them focused and partly for the social side of learning. So I'd expect a mix of both to become the norm.

tips.en: An advantage, a limitation, then a conclusion — three steps of a strong Part 3 answer.
tips.kk: Онлайнның артықшылығы, сосын шектеуі, сосын қорытынды — күшті Part 3 жауабының үш қадамы.
tips.ru: Плюс онлайна, затем ограничение, затем вывод — три шага сильного ответа Part 3.
tips.example: However, I think younger children in particular need a teacher

tips.en: Partly… and partly neatly gives two reasons in one sentence.
tips.kk: Partly… and partly — бір сөйлемде екі себепті ұқыпты береді.
tips.ru: Partly… and partly — аккуратно даёт две причины в одном предложении.
tips.example: partly to keep them focused and partly for the social side of learning

note.en: Introduces an opinion — an alternative to I think.
note.kk: Пікірді енгізеді — I think орнына балама.
note.ru: Вводит мнение — вариант к I think.

questions.question: Do you think online lessons can replace teachers in the classroom?

text: I think it's shifted quite a lot. In the past, the teacher was basically the main source of information, but now students can find almost any fact online in seconds. As a result, teachers are becoming more like guides — their job is to help students evaluate information and think critically, rather than just memorise it. Personally, I think that's a positive change, although it's much more demanding for teachers.

tips.en: Comparing past and present is a natural structure for questions about change.
tips.kk: Өткен мен бүгінді салыстыру — өзгерістер туралы сұрақтарға табиғи құрылым.
tips.ru: Сравнение прошлого и настоящего — естественная структура для вопросов о переменах.
tips.example: In the past, the teacher was basically the main source of information

tips.en: As a result gives the consequence, then a personal evaluation with a reservation.
tips.kk: As a result — салдар, сосын ескертпесі бар өз бағасы.
tips.ru: As a result — следствие, затем своя оценка с оговоркой.
tips.example: As a result, teachers are becoming more like guides

questions.question: How has the role of teachers changed in recent years?

text: Mainly because of the pay and the workload. Teachers often earn less than people with similar qualifications in business, yet they spend their evenings marking and preparing lessons. There's also the issue of status — in some places teaching isn't seen as a prestigious job anymore. Unless salaries and respect improve, bright graduates will keep choosing other careers.

tips.en: The pay and the workload names two causes, then each is explained in turn.
tips.kk: The pay and the workload — бір сөйлемде екі себеп, сосын кезекпен.
tips.ru: The pay and the workload — две причины в одной фразе, дальше по очереди.

tips.en: Unless salaries and respect improve ends with a condition and its result.
tips.kk: Unless salaries and respect improve — соңында шарт пен салдары.
tips.ru: Unless salaries and respect improve — условие и последствие в конце.

note.en: “Talented people who have just finished university”.

questions.followUp: What could make it more attractive?
questions.question: Why is teaching not a popular career choice for young people in some countries?

text: Yes, but in a supportive way. Children whose parents ask about their day, read with them and show interest in school usually do better, because they feel that learning matters. However, some parents go too far and do their children's homework or argue with teachers about every mark. That takes away the child's independence, so there's a fine line between helping and controlling.

tips.en: Yes, but in a supportive way specifies at once what kind of involvement helps.
tips.kk: Yes, but in a supportive way — қандай араласу пайдалы екенін бірден нақтылайсыз.
tips.ru: Yes, but in a supportive way — сразу уточняете, какое участие полезно.
tips.example: Yes, but in a supportive way

tips.en: However, some parents go too far gives the other side with concrete examples.
tips.kk: However, some parents go too far — нақты мысалдары бар екінші жақ.
tips.ru: However, some parents go too far — вторая сторона с конкретными примерами.
